answer: Each submission hangs on the walnut of a task receipt, and the spiral is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. By the trellis of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
